description: This file defines a Drupal migration source plugin class 'VariableTranslation' for migrating variable translations from a Drupal 6 database, specifically handling internationalization variables stored in the 'i18n_variable' table.

classes.name: VariableTranslation
classes.description: A Drupal 6 migration source plugin class for retrieving variable translations from the database.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with configuration, migration, state, and entity type manager, and sets the variables to fetch.

methods.name: initializeIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the variable values.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Fetches and returns variable translation data from the database, organized by language.

methods.name: doCount
methods.description: Returns the count of variable entries.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Returns the list of variable names as field definitions.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Builds and returns the database query to select variable data based on configured variable names.

methods.name: getIds
methods.description: Defines the ID field for the source data, which is 'language' of type string.

methods.name: checkRequirements
methods.description: Checks if the 'i18n_variable' table exists in the database schema; throws exception if not.
